mutants.name: fill_reset_dropped
mutants.old: SettingsWindow.applyWindowOpacity(win)   // the fill through AgentsNSWindow's setters, then the shadow again

mutants.name: standard_build_skips_applystyle
mutants.old: applyStyle(win)   // #2045: every style, Standard too, is built by the live switch's own path

mutants.name: rebuild_skipped
mutants.old: guard let model, old.style != Preferences.agentWindowStyle else { return Self.applyStyle(old) }
mutants.new: guard let model, old.style != old.style else { return Self.applyStyle(old) }

mutants.name: model_replaced
mutants.old: let win = Self.makeWindow(model, autosave: autosave.isEmpty ? nil : autosave, replacing: old)
mutants.new: let win = Self.makeWindow(AgentWindowModel(lastLive: lastLive, layouts: Preferences.defaults), autosave: autosave.isEmpty ? nil : autosave, replacing: old)

mutants.name: corners_only_rebuilds
mutants.old: guard let model, old.style != Preferences.agentWindowStyle else { return Self.applyStyle(old) }
mutants.new: guard let model, old.style != Preferences.agentWindowStyle || old.roundedCorners != Preferences.agentWindowRoundedCorners else { return Self.applyStyle(old) }
